gradient_QC: Q: representation losses only; C: -rsmi_weight*I + variance_weight*variance_floor + color_weight*uniform_color_NLL only
gradient_R: grad(10 L_all_start_anchor); no feedback to QC
kernel_auxiliaries: Multiscale variance_floor_ensemble weight=2.0, ratio=1.0; uniform-color NLL weight=1.0; neutral disabled; distinct retired
note: Exact full-shell empirical MI via compressed P(V|E), per-ensemble weights, all cached samples/translations; no critic or coupling labels. Large finite-sample bias is possible.

execution_optimizations.note: Same objectives/parameters/RNG draws; floating reduction order may differ. C samples are never cached; C input VJP remains active.

learning_rate_policy.clock: cumulative completed optimizer updates; first update is 1
learning_rate_policy.milestone_convention: after completing m updates, update m+1 uses the decay
learning_rate_policy.cosine_convention: update 1 uses base; update N uses floor; later updates keep floor
learning_rate_policy.parameter_groups: unchanged; all Q/C/R Adam groups share this learning rate

R_optimization.target_policy: Same pre-update online half-subset-mean Q/C encodings, detached; discarded after each batch
R_optimization.sampling: One fresh physical minibatch and stochastic C trajectory per outer batch; no resampling inside R updates
R_optimization.gradient_policy: First Q/C/R gradients simultaneous and independent; extra gradients and Adam steps affect R only
R_optimization.learning_rate: Unchanged configured Adam; any scheduler uses outer-batch clock
R_optimization.interpretation: More R optimization per moving target; not equivalent to post-training frozen-Q/C optimization or a convergence guarantee

terminal_R_fit.optimizer: Continue R Adam and current LR; Q/C weights, gradients and clocks frozen
terminal_R_fit.stopping: TRAIN plateau only; cap is reported separately; resource limits are not extended

closure_objective_contract.gradient_routing: R only; all recurrent R calls retain gradients; Q/C unchanged
closure_objective_contract.gradient_R: grad(10 L_all_start_anchor); no feedback to QC
closure_objective_contract.interpretation: Koopman-inspired multi-horizon consistency; nonlinear R, not a finite-dimensional linear Koopman operator

device_note: CPU histogram construction; model, selected batches, kernel table and MI tensor algebra on execution_device. Reports reload on CPU. Full TEST empirical MI is logged on CPU using the detached current kernel table; TRAIN MI remains on CUDA, unchanged.

train.shuffle_null_qualification: No shuffled-null comparison was computed by this statistics object.
train.note: Exact empirical MI, not population MI. Unique/rare environments can cause severe finite-sample upward bias; a high training or shuffled-null MI is not evidence of population information.

test.shuffle_null_qualification: No shuffled-null comparison was computed by this statistics object.
test.note: Exact empirical MI, not population MI. Unique/rare environments can cause severe finite-sample upward bias; a high training or shuffled-null MI is not evidence of population information.

q_reconstruction.objective: Shared cross-subset normalized histogram CE + .01 KL; equal mean over all scales
q_reconstruction.gradient: Q/decoder only; histograms detached; no Q gradient into C
q_reconstruction.encoding: R and reports use half-mean posterior means, never posterior samples
q_reconstruction.sampling: Private update/scale-indexed posterior noise; C/data RNG unchanged
q_reconstruction.initialization: Fresh random Q; TRAIN microscopic histogram centering/scaling and decoder bias only
q_reconstruction.logging: separation=mean CE+warmup*.01 KL; vae_cross_entropy/KL/effective_KL_weight per scale

module_initialization_provenance.random_construction_scope: Immediately after build_model; before warm starts or data-driven initialization
module_initialization_provenance.pre_affine_initialization_scope: After optional warm start or MI initialization; before affine decoder PCA/bias initialization
module_initialization_provenance.training_start_scope: After all model initialization/calibration; before the first optimizer update of this fresh run
module_initialization_provenance.legacy_initial_module_sha256: Pre-affine-initialization alias retained for existing scale-weight preflight compatibility
module_initialization_provenance.rng_and_parameters: Read-only state hashing; no random draws or parameter changes
